title: Show produced storage metric as numeric-only
summary: Updates the Metrics Storage subtab so the Produced total is displayed as a numeric value without a proportional bar.
reason: Produced data is expected to dominate the Storage chart scale, making the saved/growth bars harder to compare.
behavior_before: Storage metrics rendered Gross saved, Gross growth, and Produced with proportional bars sharing the same maximum scale.
behavior_after: Storage metrics render Gross saved and Gross growth as proportional bars, while Produced is shown as a value-only row.
